name: A Dark Threat Looms
objectiveText: Ashlan Stonesmirk wants you to return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir and inform him of the new discovery. Disarming Colloid (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Coords,

[b]46,13[/b]  - Loch Modan

As the above post mentions, he is standing in the middle of the Stonewrought Dam beneath a tent.
This little dude is on the Dam - he's right about in the middle.
For those of U with Coords he is at 46,13
You get 340 exp. for this quest.
replies: I'm having trouble on the ogre things, there all elites, i can kill maybe 1 at a time, but it's just awkward when you dont know were the crystal is located =\
Check out the next quest in this series. I (and others) have posted useful information about it.

comments.body: For those without, after entering wetlands, take the second intersection to the north.  The turn will have a dwarf npc with a quest and a goblin vender.  Go north and right before you hit Thandol Span (the big bridge) you'll fine the dude.
